routes.mount: SafeRoute named ActiveSessions; lazy import at App.tsx:328

purpose: Account security surface for reviewing and revoking TeslaSync-issued browser/device sessions. This is not vehicle telemetry, charging sessions, historical account activity, Tesla account disconnection, or upstream identity-provider session management.
primaryGoal: Recognize the current device and unfamiliar signed-in devices, inspect their network and activity metadata, and deliberately sign out another device or all other devices without signing out this tab.

dataSources.owner: sessionHandler.List; handler constructed from authSessionsRepo in internal\api\router.go:739-740
behavior: Query key ['sessions','list']; 30-second staleTime; refetchOnWindowFocus false; enabled defaults true.
Forwards query AbortSignal to request; normalizes missing payload sessions to an empty array.
AUTH_MODE_OPEN error code becomes successful discriminated union {mode:'open'}; other errors propagate.
ActiveSession fields: id, user_agent, ip, created_at, last_seen_at, optional revoked_at, current.
Account-wide latest list, not workspace vehicle or date scoped. Do not add date or vehicle selectors.
dataSources.limits: No HTTP request or repository/handler implementation execution. Router source confirms registration, not deployed reachability or database behavior.

behavior: RequireNotImpersonating and RequireSudo gates are registered upstream.
No optimistic row removal; successful mutation invalidates/broadcasts sessions list and displays success toast; failure displays error toast.
Page closes confirmation onSettled, including failure or canceled reauthentication.
dataSources.limits: Hook comments describe idempotent 204 responses; handler was not inspected, so this is documented intent rather than independently established server behavior. No mutation executed.

behavior: Registered before dynamic id route; RequireNotImpersonating and RequireSudo gates.
Successful mutation invalidates/broadcasts list and toasts returned revoked count, with nullish fallback zero.
Header action exists only in session mode with at least one non-current session.
Current-session exclusion based on inbound cookie is described in page comments, not independently verified in handler.
dataSources.limits: No mutation executed; no claim that provider cookies, Tesla credentials or another application's account are revoked.

behavior: request normalizes /api/v1 prefix and rejects prohibited offline security writes before transport.
401 SUDO_REQUIRED invokes existing challenge provider and replays once after credential acquisition; canceled challenge rejects.
deriveDataState keeps retained data after refresh error or paused refresh; fatalError only replaces never-loaded source.
dataSources.limits: No credentials inspected, recorded or exercised; no auth prompt bypassed.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing category-barrel layout; forwards PageContainer props, min-w-0, full-width container, query freshness, destructiveActions and copyLink. No replacement header or width engine.

components.name: SessionsSummaryCards / SettingsSummaryBrief
components.kind: feature presentation composed with shared OperationalBrief
components.contract: Four typed StatMetric identities, missing source suppression, loading/unavailable/retained states; existing useOperationalMetrics bridge and shared brief. Keep account/latest-list scope and exact timestamp context.

components.name: SessionBreakdownPanel / MetricBar
components.contract: title/icon/items/total, independent loading/error/retry/empty, colorOffset. MetricBar exposes named progressbar, raw count and denominator, reduced motion, solid or gradient fill.

components.name: SessionsTable / DataTable
components.contract: Five columns; stable id settings:active-sessions, row.id keys, loaded-row value filters, pagination and shared table preferences/export pipeline. Mobile currently keeps device/last_seen_at/actions. Current rows have This device badge and no revoke control.

components.name: SessionsOpenModeNotice
components.contract: Named region and localized forward-auth configuration explanation; intentionally no in-app enablement action.

components.name: Button / ConfirmDialog / feedback / FadeIn
components.contract: Two distinct danger confirmations, no silenceKey. Pending disables cancel/confirm and suppresses Escape/backdrop dismissal. Reuse Modal focus owner; reduced-motion entrances reuse useMotionPreference. Skeleton/QueryError/EmptyState/DataStateNotice remain canonical.

components.name: computeSessionStats / describeDevice / useDateFormat
components.contract: Pure counts, first current row, non-current count, maximum valid timestamp, descending-count then label sorting. Browser/OS heuristics are best effort; network groups by exact IP string, not geolocation or subnet.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Three sibling breakdown configurations use one SessionBreakdownPanel implementation; repeated loading/error/empty rendering is already centralized there. Separate destructive dialogs represent different security actions, not competing systems.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain shared panel and explicit action distinctions; do not extract another global breakdown or confirmation engine without independent consumer evidence.

sourceBehavior: ActiveSessionsPage.tsx:134 uses one column, md two columns, xl three columns.
SessionsTable.tsx:131-132 uses min-w-0 and responsive padding.
ActiveSessionsPage.tsx:84 enables wrapLabel on bulk action.
DataTable.tsx:238-248,714-725 applies hidden md:table-cell to columns outside mobileColumns.

issues.detail: mobileColumns excludes IP address and Signed in timestamp below md; this caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor an expandable/detail renderer. Those security-relevant fields lose direct table-cell reachability on the mobile surface.
issues.fix: Use existing DataTable mobilePresentation with role/displayValue mappings, allDetails for all five columns and inlineActions preserving current-row exclusion; preserve 640-767 branch details too, or keep omitted fields reachable with the existing semantic table/scroll strategy. Do not remove columns, filters or timestamps.

responsive.requiredChecks: All contract widths 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560 plus allocated container widths, long browser/IP labels, dialog-open states and text zoom. No viewport or overflow measurement performed.

sourceStrengths: Named summary and table sections (SessionsSummaryCards.tsx:72-76; SessionsTable.tsx:131).
Breakdown heading aria-labelledby and decorative icon hiding (ActiveSessionsPage.tsx:130-133; SessionBreakdownPanel.tsx:60).
Device-specific localized revoke aria-label and This device text badge; not color-only (SessionsTable.tsx:62-69,112-118).
MetricBar named progressbar with numeric bounds and unknown reading text (MetricBar.tsx:56-63).

FadeIn and MetricBar consult existing reduced-motion preference.

issues.detail: Page passes query, but not loading/error, to PageLayout. PageContainer's load announcement reads loading/error props rather than query; summary's aria-busy covers only its section. The page-level announcement transition is not wired to the sessions source.
issues.fix: During implementation verify announcement behavior; if absent, pass initial-loading and fatal-error through existing layout props while ensuring PageContainer's replacement branch does not hide the preserved sections, or use the existing status-announcement contract without duplicate announcements.

unverified: Keyboard order, focus restoration/trap and Escape behavior in actual dialogs.
Effective light/dark/forced-colors contrast and 44px mobile action reachability.
RTL, 200% text and actual OS reduced-motion behavior.

states.initialLoading: deriveDataState initial drives summary suppression and 168px breakdown/240px table skeletons. All normal sections remain mounted.
states.successfulEmpty: Session-mode empty array gives genuine zero total/other counts; breakdown EmptyStates and DataTable empty message remain. No all-others action.
states.openMode: AUTH_MODE_OPEN becomes a successful unavailable capability notice, not an error or fabricated zero-session account. Normal summary/breakdown/table body is intentionally replaced by this mode-specific explanation.
states.fatalError: Summary, each breakdown and table show QueryError with refetch callback, while metric source is unavailable rather than zero.
states.retainedRefreshError: deriveDataState preserves data; page shows stale notice; summary retained status and existing rows/breakdowns/actions remain. FatalError false prevents whole-source replacement.
states.offlinePaused: Retained paused query derives stale/isRefreshBlocked; page uses generic stale notice. request rejects prohibited offline security writes; no queued revocations. Actual offline UI not exercised.
states.pendingMutations: Row id disabled during individual revoke; bulk button busy/disabled during bulk mutation. Corresponding dialog loading disables dismissal. No optimistic row removal.
states.successFailureCancel: Hooks own success/error toast and list invalidation/broadcast. Page closes active confirmation onSettled for either outcome; cancel before confirmation just clears local target/state.

issues.rule: MDC-026 unknown is not a measured absence
issues.detail: Null lastActive is rendered as Never even for non-empty lists whose timestamps are missing or invalid. sessionStats skips invalid timestamps at lines 69-74, so null cannot prove sessions have never been active.
issues.fix: Distinguish successful empty-list absence from unknown/invalid latest activity with existing localized unknown/unavailable presentation; keep valid relative and absolute timestamp context and do not alter raw API values.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010/MDC-034; mission sections 7/43 restrained accent budget
visualIssues.detail: Categorical rows cycle the eight saturated chart colors with offsets 0/2/4 across three panels. MetricBar defaults to gradient fill. This introduces rainbow/gradient emphasis to non-semantic account breakdowns, including red/amber/green with no risk meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing restrained theme accent and MetricBar fill='solid' for these non-semantic counts; preserve every group/count/denominator/order and all configured user theme identities. Do not change the shared chart palette globally.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative heading icons use fixed text-cyan-300, rather than neutral/theme semantic text. Their repeated bright emphasis is not account risk information; effective contrast across themes is unknown.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing muted/secondary or subdued theme-accent token while retaining decorative aria-hidden semantics.

priority.first: Preserve mobile security metadata and unknown-activity semantics.
priority.next: Subdue categorical rainbow/gradient noise and validate existing layout/announcement/security dialog contracts.
priority.rationale: Already decomposed into feature presentation, typed hooks and shared layout/table/brief/security primitives. No broad rewrite, account mutation or competing implementation is justified.

requiredSharedChanges.note: No alternative auth, session store, overlay system or queued mutation implementation.

competingImplementations.evidence: Scoped page uses existing PageLayout, DataTable, OperationalBrief bridge, MetricBar and ConfirmDialog. Barrel index re-exports existing session components; derivation is pure rather than duplicated server state.
competingImplementations.limit: No application-wide competitor search performed; absence is limited to assigned page and inspected dependencies.

actions: Page copy link and query freshness supplied through existing layout.

Local table value filtering, sorting/preferences, paging and inherited loaded-row export pipeline; do not silently disable or replace it. Actual export serialization and toolbar behavior not executed.
Retry/refetch from fatal-error and breakdown empty states.
Individual sign-out only for non-current sessions; device-specific accessible label and confirmation message.
All-other-device sign-out only when non-current sessions exist; preserve current tab exclusion semantics.
Each destructive confirmation has explicit cancel and confirm, remains nonsilenceable, and blocks dismissal while its mutation is pending.
Existing summary brief details/provenance context must remain available through shared owner; not independently exercised.
dataBehavior: TeslaSync app cookie bindings only; upstream IdP cookie/session untouched according to types.ts:3328-3331 and router.go:730-738. Do not imply Tesla account or provider logout.
Keep open/session discriminant, current device flag, stable row id and list query key.
Do not expose session cookies, credential tokens or signing secrets in audit or UI. id is row identity; not a displayed credential.
Keep original snake_case payload fields and raw timestamps; display dates through existing locale/timezone formatting.
Keep best-effort device parser ordering (Edge/Opera before Chrome; iOS before macOS; Android before Linux) and unknown em-dash fallback.
Network grouping is exact IP; do not invent IP geolocation, reputation, subnet or security scores.
Retain total/non-current counts, maximum valid last_seen_at and deterministic breakdown ordering.
Successful empty lists are genuine zero counts; unknown source values must remain unavailable, not zero.
Retained refresh failures preserve rows and confirmed-only actions; no optimistic revoke or persisted/offline queue.
Retain success/error toasts, invalidation/broadcast and closing onSettled; do not change confirmation cancellation behavior.
No physical unit fields are involved; no SI conversion or wire/cache changes authorized.
No date range, selected vehicle or admin/account impersonation capabilities invented.
